description: Lowest-priced product in each eligible Sense2 category, ranked at minimum order, with market prices and qualifying quantities. Filter by category or page using total and nextOffset.

category.description: Optional category name substring or id, e.g. 'pens', 'tote', '57'

locale.description: en-AU, en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP. Defaults to the endpoint host's market.

offset.description: Skip the first N entries (default 0) — use nextOffset from the previous page

name: get_cheapest_by_category
